brief: Edinburgh Castle with stepped wards, open Crown Square and Hospital Square, Royal Palace and octagonal clock turret, Great Hall, Queen Anne range, Scottish National War Memorial, St Margaret chapel, New Barracks, Governors House, Half Moon and Argyle batteries, and open gate passages.

groundCutout.basis: Mapped drawbridge,gate passages and winding cobbled route connect the eastern gate to CrownSquare. Owner visual-story pages7–11 confirm drawbridge,open entrance and steep cobbled path. Reconstructed4.8m exterior width is not a survey. A4m terrain mask retains a0.4m overlap beneath the paving edges to prevent exposed ground-cut seams. Working gate floors0/7m clamp interpolated terrain under the two passages; remaining road follows retained relative terrain. Existing20.2m court paving covers the shared end. Cap triangulation is split at local gate floor and approach thresholds. Unloading restores terrain. Cap triangulation is split at each mapped gate floor and graded approach threshold; this prevents long road triangles from interpolating a floor across the passage. Court mask is intersected with every detail-level cap perimeter so level changes cannot expose sky along simplified paving edges.
